categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of digital X-ray flat panel detectors, which are core components of digital X-ray imaging systems. Its products cover medical imaging (including general radiography, mammography, dynamic imaging, radiotherapy, dental 3D imaging, and veterinary applications), industrial non-destructive testing, security inspection, and pet medical fields. The company also develops intelligent DR solutions and imaging technology solutions, expanding from hardware components to integrated systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company masters key technologies including amorphous silicon TFT/PD design and manufacturing, cesium iodide scintillator evaporation and packaging, dynamic series high-level application technology, AED and DAEC technologies (wired and wireless), intelligent collimators, and intelligent DR solutions. It independently produces critical components such as cesium iodide scintillators via evaporation technology and controls core manufacturing processes to ensure product quality and protect proprietary technology. The company also develops image processing software integrated with hardware for enhanced imaging performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include manufacturers of digital X-ray imaging systems serving hospitals, veterinary clinics, industrial enterprises, and security inspection departments. The company’s products are used in medical institutions for clinical diagnostics, pet healthcare, industrial non-destructive testing, and security screening. Major end markets are medical imaging, industrial inspection, security, and pet medical sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with expanding international presence through subsidiaries and sales centers in the United States, India, Japan, South Korea, Italy, and Singapore. It actively develops markets in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America, and the Middle East, leveraging local subsidiaries and partnerships to enhance regional service and sales capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, assembly, and testing of digital X-ray flat panel detectors and related imaging solutions. It controls key upstream processes such as scintillator evaporation and TFT/PD design and manufacturing, while outsourcing lower value-added assembly steps. It supplies core components to digital X-ray system manufacturers and provides integrated imaging solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening R&D in digital X-ray flat panel detectors, expanding into intelligent imaging solutions, and advancing key components like collimators, X-ray tubes, and high-voltage generators. The company emphasizes innovation in CMOS sensors, IGZO metal oxide sensors, photon counting detectors, and flexible substrate detectors. It pursues global market expansion, strengthens sales channels, and integrates business with invested companies to accelerate technology application and market penetration.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of digital X-ray flat panel detectors and related components, as well as integrated intelligent DR imaging solutions. The company sells directly and through distributors to domestic and international customers. It also earns income from customized product development and after-sales services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is among fewer than 20 global manufacturers of digital X-ray flat panel detectors, competing with international leaders such as Varex, Trixell, Canon, and Fujifilm. It ranks ninth globally and second domestically in market share for medical and veterinary digital X-ray flat panel detectors. The company is recognized for its technological innovation and growing market presence, particularly in cesium iodide-based detectors and intelligent imaging solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 298.1 million, an 8.9% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 17.65 million, a 14.54% increase. R&D investment accounted for 14.67% of revenue. The company maintains steady growth with improving profitability and cash flow, supported by expanding product lines and market development.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes advanced proprietary technologies such as high-yield cesium iodide evaporation, amorphous silicon TFT/PD manufacturing, and integrated intelligent DR solutions to deliver high-resolution, low-dose, and high-dynamic-range imaging products. Its comprehensive product portfolio covers all major application fields, offering customization and integrated solutions that enhance customer value. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, quality control, and global service network differentiate it in the competitive digital X-ray imaging market.
